tasks.label: Free preview ports
tasks.command: for p in 5500 5501 5502 5503; do for pid in $(fuser ${p}/tcp 2>/dev/null); do if tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'extensionHost|--type=|vscode|code-server|electron'; then echo "Port $p is held by an editor process ($pid); stop that Live Preview server first." >&2; else kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; done; sleep 0.3; exit 0

tasks.label: Start App Live Preview :5500
tasks.command: echo "${input:startAppServer}" >/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 100); do (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5500) 2>/dev/null && (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5501) 2>/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.2; done; echo 'Live Preview App server did not start on 5500 (HTTP) / 5501 (WS). Install the Live Preview extension (ms-vscode.live-server), run Developer: Reload Window, and open garagebox.code-workspace (not the folder alone).' >&2; exit 1

tasks.label: Start Blueprints Live Preview :5502
tasks.command: echo "${input:startBlueprintsServer}" >/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 100); do (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5502) 2>/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.2; done; echo 'Live Preview Blueprints server did not start on 5502 (HTTP). Install the Live Preview extension (ms-vscode.live-server), run Developer: Reload Window, and open garagebox.code-workspace (not the folder alone).' >&2; exit 1

tasks.label: Wait until App and Blueprints serve GarageBox
tasks.command: for i in $(seq 1 75); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:5500/ | grep -q 'GarageBox' && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:5502/ | grep -q 'GarageBox' && exit 0; sleep 0.2; done; echo 'Preview check failed: http://127.0.0.1:5500/ (App) and http://127.0.0.1:5502/ (Blueprints) must both return a page containing GarageBox.' >&2; exit 1

tasks.label: Open Blueprints in editor
dependsOn: Wait until App and Blueprints serve GarageBox
